jobs.description: The International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging and Structural Dynamics in Hamburg, Germany, offers a structured PhD program focusing on ultra-fast phenomena, X-ray physics and dynamical imaging in all areas of science, covering physics, chemistry and biology.23 Interdisciplinary doctoral PhD projects in the fields of Ultrafast Science and Quantum Materials The program offers exciting research opportunities at ultra-intense electron and X-ray sources to directly observe atomic motions during primary events.
